exposure: Fetal factors (chromosomal abnormalities, nervous system disorders, thalassemia major)
cohort: The study included 131 pregnant patients who underwent legal, therapeutic abortions after obtaining permission from the Forensic Medicine Organization in a hospital in northern Iran between 2018 and 2022.
finding: The most common etiological factors for therapeutic abortions were maternal cardiovascular complications and fetal factors, predominantly chromosomal abnormalities, nervous system disorders, and thalassemia major, with most cases managed by simultaneous misoprostol and curettage.
